cleared.check: Task 3: the returned words against arithmetic that does not come from src/. For each swap the exact amounts over the part of the move inside the position, A0 = L*2^96*(b-a)/(a*b) and A1 = L*(b-a)/2^96 as Fractions; the pool must receive gross g with g*(1e6-f) >= 1e6*A_in, pay o <= A_out, take at most |amountSpecified| on exact input, pay at most amountSpecified on exact output, credit fee growth of at most g - A_in, and after settlement hold the deposits plus the swap delta. Donate: delta equals the amounts, fee growth is floor(a*2^128/L) and the PoolManager holds deposits plus donation. Clear, settleFor and ERC-6909: conservation of deltas, token units and claims.
cleared.result: 1031 successful cases, no violation. In the rest a step reverted, with the same revert data on every network and in the reference (swap 326, liquidity add 18, donate 19). The check can fail: a one-unit overpayment planted consistently in the swap delta, the driver's delta and the PoolManager balance is caught in 595 of 892 successful swaps (the rest have at least one unit of rounding margin in the pool's favour), and a one-unit excess of fee growth in 70 of 70 donates. The same checks on the MegaETH, HyperEVM, Monad and Ethereum answers give no violation.

cleared.check: Task 4: the overflow fallback of getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp (src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:40-52). Boundaries per price; whether a wrapped product can pass line 43; and whether a swap step can reach the fallback and return.
cleared.result: A wrapped product never passes line 43: with a*s >= 2^256 the EVM product is a*s - k*2^256 < a*s, so its quotient by a is below s (300020 searched pairs, seed 25025, none). Line 45 wraps for a in [ceil((2^256 - L*2^96)/s), floor((2^256-1)/s)]. Because the fallback consumes the whole remaining amount, the specified amount must fit int128 at src/libraries/Pool.sol:455-459, so a <= 2^127 and the step starts above 2^128.99 (a positive tick). TickBitmap.nextInitializedTickWithinOneWord never targets below the start of the word that holds tick 0 (src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:85-105), so the target is at least 2^96; a below the amount to target then needs L*s/s_t > 2^160, the pool must hold more than about 2^160 units of currency1 in that range, and the step output is at least about 2^64*s_t, above 2^127, so amountCalculated.toInt128 reverts. 46206 sampled reachable inputs (16637 at line 45, 29569 at line 43) all give an output of at least 2^160, a next price at or above the exact N/(N/s + a) and at or above the target. No grid swap with real deposits reached the fallback (no case of ids 0 to 1394 took pc 23900 fallthrough or pc 23942 taken). With pool state written by override (spacing 32767, L 2^100, 2^120 and 2^128-1, prices 2^130, 2^150 and 2^159.9) 54 swaps were run around the boundaries and 24 of them reached the fallback through line 43 or line 45; all 54 revert with SafeCastOverflow on all 21 networks, in the reference and in Monad's interpreter and native code. A wrong word there cannot pay out the real currency: no input lets the swap return.

leads.question: Why does the cycle 23 Monad harness give varying interpreter results for the same scenario when its world holds about 3,000 token accounts (out/hx/rep1369.txt), and do earlier harness runs that used large worlds need a rerun?
leads.why: The harness is the only evidence for Monad's compiled path on inputs no mined transaction used; a host fault that depends on world size could hide or invent an engine difference.

leads.question: Run the four sides this unit left out (hook return delta at src/PoolManager.sol:181, a hook zeroing the amount at src/libraries/Pool.sol:320, native settle with value while an ERC-20 is synced at :356, and a failed native payout at src/types/Currency.sol:51) through the same eth_call driver with a hook double and a native balance override.
leads.why: They are the only producer-unexecuted sides not yet run on all 21 networks; two need a hook (pool-creator) and two only native value.

leadResults.answer: In a hookless pool with real deposits, prices 2^158 to MAX_SQRT_PRICE-1 and exact-input zeroForOne amounts 2^97 to 2^127, every step either reaches its target or takes the precise path at SqrtPriceMath.sol:47; the fallback needs a step from above 2^129 to a target at or above 2^96 with L*s/s_t > 2^160, so more than about 2^160 units of currency1 in range, and its output always exceeds int128, so Pool.sol:455-459 reverts. Run with pool state by override, both fallback lines execute on all 21 networks, in pyevm and in Monad's interpreter and native code at v0.16.5 and v0.16.7, and every run reverts with SafeCastOverflow. No mined MegaETH, HyperEVM or Monad transaction executed them (cycle 24 counts). A wrong price there cannot pay out the real token.

Not searched for a log index in this unit. The sides it asks about (donate, ERC-6909 transfer and approval, swaps near a price bound) were run instead through eth_call on Monad's endpoint and through Monad's interpreter and native code, with the reference result.
